candidates.description: This vector represents abstract nouns and adverbial connectors relating to ways, manners, instances, or general conditions.
This vector represents common Spanish verbs, particularly forms related to past actions and auxiliary verb roots.
This vector activates in contexts related to sports and games.
This vector represents common Spanish grammatical words, adjectives, and adverbial modifiers used in descriptive discourse.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the letter sequence "iz" or related Spanish morphological roots.
These tokens represent Spanish and Portuguese nominal and adjectival suffixes related to agent nouns, past participles, and feminine/plural inflections.
This vector represents geographic regions, countries, and global place names.
This vector is related to Spanish-language suffixes, terms, and Caribbean-related proper nouns.
This vector represents common Spanish temporal adverbs, connectors, and sequential transition words.
This feature vector activates on terms and suffixes related to cricket scoring, boundaries, and fielding positions.
